abstract: Therapeutic course of 2 cases of nonseminomatous testicular tumor with liver metastasis is reported. One case had mixed tumors including embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma and yolk sac carcinoma, and was positive pulmonary metastasis already at the initial examination. In the other case having mixed tumors of embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma, metastasis to the supraclavicular lymph node was detected at the initial examination. In both cases liver metastasis occurred after complete response could be obtained by treatment chiefly consisting of PVB therapy. For liver metastasis four-drug combination treatment using cisplatin, vinblastine, adriamycin and actinomycin D was performed with partial response. However, this patient eventually died. The other case received VAB-6 therapy with complete response for liver metastasis. It is advisable to consider other modalities therapy in addition to conventional chemotherapy in cases of testicular tumor with liver metastasis since the prognosis is poor in these cases.
abstract_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍で肝転移を有した2例の治療経過を報告する。症例1は胎児性癌、絨毛癌、卵黄嚢癌の混合腫瘍であり、初診時にすでに肺転移陽性であった。症例2は胎児性癌と絨毛癌の混合腫瘍で、初診時に鎖骨上リンパ節転移が検出された。両症例とも、主にPVB療法による治療で完全奏効が得られた後に肝転移が出現した。肝転移に対しては、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、アドリアマイシン、アクチノマイシンDの4剤併用療法を行い部分奏効が得られたが、この患者は最終的に死亡した。もう1例はVAB-6療法を受け、肝転移に対して完全奏効が得られた。肝転移を伴う精巣腫瘍の予後は不良であるため、従来の化学療法に加えて他の治療法を検討することが望ましい。
